status: Hand-authored examples; expected properties were written by hand, not produced by running the engine.
contractBasis: SPEC CHOICE SC-01, SC-03, SC-04 and SC-06 in the main BBB; inherited source object shape must be checked against the selected public core.
method: Expectations are manually specified from the proposed contract, not computed by a copied evidence or graph implementation.

cases.description: Complete required evidence; not business approval.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: approval is KNOWN true; effort is KNOWN 5; optional note is UNKNOWN.
Required coverage is 2 of 2.
Evidence status COMPLETE; routing disposition null.
Final decision remains null and NOT_EVALUATED. No BUILD or ALLOW is emitted.
effort is UNKNOWN; approval remains KNOWN.
Evidence routing is NEEDS_EVIDENCE, addressed to owner-planning with a question naming effort.
Final decision remains unevaluated.

cases.description: Two current authorized, type-valid integer values disagree.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: effort is CONFLICT, has no selected value, and retains EV-EFFORT and EV-EFFORT-OTHER.
NEEDS_EVIDENCE routes the conflict question to owner-planning; majority/recency does not select a value.

cases.description: Unauthorized contradictory claim alongside valid support.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: EV-EFFORT-UNAUTHORIZED is excluded with UNAUTHORIZED_ISSUER.
effort remains KNOWN 5, not CONFLICT, because excluded evidence does not participate in conflict resolution.
The exclusion action stays visible even though required evidence is complete.

cases.description: Only effort record is from an undeclared issuer.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: EV-EFFORT is excluded with UNAUTHORIZED_ISSUER; effort is UNKNOWN.
NEEDS_EVIDENCE contains owner-planning and a concrete replacement question.

cases.description: Evidence is attached to WORK-A but declares another subject.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: EV-EFFORT is excluded with WRONG_SUBJECT; its subject is not repaired.
effort is UNKNOWN with a field-owner replacement question.
EV-EFFORT is EXPIRED at the half-open boundary and excluded; effort is UNKNOWN.
EV-EFFORT is CURRENT and remains usable; effort is KNOWN 5.
EV-EFFORT is FUTURE and excluded; no host wall clock changes that result.

cases.description: Missing item dependency is a semantic graph gap.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: Link reports MISSING_DEPENDENCY for WORK-A with WORK-MISSING.
NEEDS_EVIDENCE routes a graph question to owner-work-a; no edge is silently dropped.
Link reports DEPENDENCY_CYCLE for WORK-A, including the self-loop.
The item has a routed graph question and no final business decision.

cases.description: Known false disqualifier with another missing required field.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: approval is KNOWN false and preserved; effort is UNKNOWN.
M1 evidence routing asks for missing effort, but finalDecision stays null / NOT_EVALUATED.
This fixture must not claim the eventual M3 business decision is NEEDS_EVIDENCE; full REJECT precedence is deferred.

cases.description: String value for a declared integer is malformed typed input.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: INVALID_INPUT before semantic stages; no public Facts result or business decision.
The parser/validator does not coerce the string to integer 5.

cases.description: A current authorized claim depends on excluded evidence.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: EV-PREREQUISITE is excluded with UNAUTHORIZED_ISSUER.
EV-EFFORT remains time-CURRENT but is unavailable through its prerequisite; effort is UNKNOWN.
The dependency and underlying exclusion survive in the trace; filtering must not resurrect the child.

cases.description: No required fields: coverage is a count, not confidence.
manuallySpecifiedExpectedProperties: Coverage counts are 0 of 0; no percentage, confidence, division by zero or NaN is manufactured.
Final business decision remains unevaluated.
